preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(h, list) and len(h) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**12 for x in h) and all(h[i] < h[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: h is a list of n integers where each integer is between 0 and 10^12 inclusive, and the list is strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and len(return_value) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**12 for x in return_value) and all(return_value[i] <= return_value[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers where each integer is between 0 and 10^12 inclusive, and the list is non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(not (return_value[i] + 2 <= return_value[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: For all j satisfying 1 <= j <= n - 1, h_j + 2 is not less than or equal to h_{j + 1} after the landslide ends.
